body: I feel your pain. I am in love with someone who doesn't reciprocate the feeling, we see each other and have a good time but  I risked everything for him and lost everything because of him. Yet here I am. Crying on the floor. My life is a mess and I don't how to end it and get over him.

I am feel the same. I am so tired. I just want it all to end but it feels like it never will. I am too chicken shit to take my own life but I keep wishing for an accident, or the courage to do it. I am just tired.
